message:
test(safety): the AVD fixture's host goes through the shared injection / power guard (keepalive-r2 e, after merging ka-r3 d665957)

mobile_abr_session_e2e_test -- every scenario, directoryhost (the AVD fixture's hosts) included --
starts its host with e2e_injection_off_arg (--input-injection-mode none --host-power-management
off), adopts it into a verified kill-on-close job (e2e_adopt_or_invalid), lets no client near it
before THIS launch said both whole OFF lines (e2e_wait_injection_off, else INVALID exit 2), keeps
judging it while it lives (E2eInjectionMonitor), and ends it the shared way: polling stops, the job
is ended and that end confirmed, the log read to EOF and the final snapshot judged
(e2e_final_file / Finalize), the job closed after; every launch judged before the result. No
variant of the guard. Built only -- nothing run (no AVD, host or emulator).
